claim: Built on Symfony and Backbone.js; core framework, extension framework, automation bundle, mailbox component and support center bundle
Features list: unlimited agents, groups, customers and tickets; no limit on mailbox integrations; saved replies; notes; knowledge base and FAQ; API bundle
Requirements: PHP 8.1, MySQL 5.7.23 or higher, Apache or Nginx, 4GB RAM, PHP IMAP and Mailparse
Install by Composer or zip archive, then terminal command or web installer; Docker and Vagrant guides in wiki; Amazon AMI
Modules and apps are available from a separate Webkul store
